summary: Frontend-only regression test of the /subscribe -> Back to dashboard bug fix in ProviderDashboard.js. Verified UNPAID provider sees 'Activate your profile' banner + 'Choose a plan' CTA on initial dashboard load, after 1st round-trip to /subscribe and back, and after 2nd round-trip. Regression verified PAID provider still sees 'Profile status: online' with expiry days and auto-renew toggle and NO activate-cta. All 4 test cases pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct: banner div (data-testid=subscription-banner) now renders unconditionally and falls back to 'Activate your profile' when !subscription?.featured_active. This handles the case where getMySubscription silently fails/returns null after navigating back from /subscribe.
ProviderDashboard.js is ~2735 lines — consider splitting into smaller modules (banner, messages, invoices, verification sections) for maintainability. Not blocking this bug fix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end. Unpaid banner persists across multiple /subscribe round-trips. Paid provider shows correct 'online' status banner with 6 days remaining and auto-renew toggle. Two console 401 errors observed on /login before auth completes — expected pre-login behaviour, not a bug.
rca of the issue: Previous code gated the entire banner div behind `{subscription && ...}`. When getMySubscription() returned null/failed silently (which happened after coming back from /subscribe), the whole banner including the activation notice disappeared. Fix renders the wrapper div unconditionally and defaults to the activation notice whenever subscription?.featured_active is falsy, ensuring unpaid state is always surfaced.
